section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses several problems with existing measures of creative achievement. It highlights issues such as techniques applying only to deceased or socially eminent creators, reliance on subjective ratings that are costly and lengthy, and creative achievement inventories failing to discriminate levels of achievement or confounding achievement with other constructs like cognitive ability, motivation, and personality.
